shortDescription: HyperX Cloud Stinger 2 Core Gaming Headset PS edition black (PlayStation 5 & PlayStation 4 Compatible / 40mm Dynamic Drivers / Flip-to-Mute Noise-Canceling Mic / On-Ear Volume Wheel / Soft Fabric Ear Cushions / 1-Yea
descriptionHtml:
HyperX Cloud Stinger 2 Core Gaming Headset PS edition black (PlayStation 5 & PlayStation 4 Compatible / 40mm Dynamic Drivers / Flip-to-Mute Noise-Canceling Mic / On-Ear Volume Wheel / Soft Fabric Ear Cushions / 1-Year Local Warranty)

Experience lightweight comfort and immersive console audio with the HyperX Cloud Stinger 2 Core Gaming Headset PS edition black, available at Turbo Computer Egypt backed by a full 1-Year official local agent warranty layout. Tailored specifically for console gamers, this lightweight 275-gram wired gaming headset connects directly to DualSense and DualShock wireless controllers via its 3.5mm jack. Equipped with custom-tuned 40mm dynamic directional drivers with enhanced bass reproduction, it delivers clear in-game sound effects and footsteps. It features an intuitive swivel-to-mute flexible microphone alongside integrated ear-cup volume controls for seamless adjustments during intense gaming sessions.
